CustomField.description: Conflicts between sources, enum gaps (a stated term no picklist value fits, left blank rather than mapped to the closest value), missing referenced terms and ambiguities - one per line, as [kind] Field: note | stated: "..." | files. Reported by the extraction model (its Issues key) and by Apex (unmapped picklist answers, renewal clauses without an allowed notice period, non-USD currency).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Issues the extraction found and left visible instead of guessing: source conflicts, enum gaps, missing referenced terms.
CustomField.label: Extraction Issues
